institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Ergonomic Sanitation Hardware / Waste Collection Tool
problem_solved: Standard manual litter grabbers or pincers feature flimsy jaw mechanisms that slip frequently, strain the operator's wrist, and fail to capture non-uniform objects securely.
description: An ergonomic manual waste collection tool engineered with a rigid hollow body casing, an integrated hand grip lever, an internal guide spike rod, a fixed lower jaw plate, and a spring-assisted pivoting upper jaw mechanism that alternates mechanically with the spike action.
applications: Public park civic sanitation, municipal street litter collection, industrial factory floor scrap handling, and residential estate maintenance gear kits.
secondary_sector: Water, Environment & Waste Management, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
